item.title: Agentic Development: What Actually Works in Legacy Java
item.description:
For six months I've been running coding agents on a real legacy codebase — Java 17, Spring Boot, 4,000+ files, multi-tenant SQL Server. Not toy problems: production bug fixes, SDLC-style feature work, security remediation, performance regressions. The agents got better. I got better at knowing what to let them do, and what to make them stop doing.

This post opens a series on the handful of patterns that actually paid off.
